answer: The cipher chain is verified at intake and comet publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 8 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 8 epochs old, anchored at a opal checkpoint. Repeating the trick 51 times costs 49 separate deposits and 8 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
